metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the dawn you looked at, the call from a house in black, and one line on a slip.

yesterday: The dawn you looked at was already written. You shut it. Sunday may have the fair copy.
Sir Thomas Heneage died this day at the Savoy. My lord is with his mother. You sent your duty.
A widow must first cast up the accounts. The Chaucer waits on a quieter house. The line asks who pays.
The line for Heminges is the line. It asks who pays.
She asked about a good end. The jaw is still tender.
